shared_elements: low-relief carving on a rectangular stone slab/block
quadruped animal shown in strict profile
horizontal band of small repeated motifs running across the surface
division of the surface into registers/zones
weathered, chipped stone surface with monochrome earth tone
justification: Both are weathered rectangular stone blocks bearing shallow relief that includes a profile quadruped and at least one horizontal band of small repeated motifs dividing the field into registers, which is the most specific correspondence. Beyond that they diverge sharply: A is a modelled, anatomically detailed narrative scene of harnessed animals, a wheeled vehicle and human figures filling the whole panel, while B is a flat, schematic assembly of isolated animal signs with no figures, no narrative and no shared placement of the banded pattern (bottom in A, top in B).
